translation_method: Project AI-assisted translation of each frozen English label; no model download, training or remote document upload.
scope: Only the 722 labels missing Chinese in the frozen display input; preserve all 176 pre-existing translations.
review_policy: All entries are project drafts, not externally sourced official Chinese labels or specialist-confirmed translations.
Preserve the source identity, exact English name, genetic symbols, cytogenetic coordinates, NOS, grades, behavior and differentiation qualifiers.
Do not infer organ names, diagnoses or molecular mechanisms absent from the English label. The tree retains parent context.
Retain historical source terminology instead of silently upgrading it to a newer disease classification.
Coverage measures label availability, not translation accuracy; rare or historical terms still need domain review.

terminology_spot_checks.purpose: Check Acrospiroma meaning without adding source-absent apocrine/eccrine qualifiers.
Chinese terminology context for acrospiroma; project draft remains the display status.
Check spiradenoma sweat-gland context; retain source wording and draft status.
Chinese Journal of Pathology 2023 uses 体细胞型 for somatic-type; correct the project draft terminology while retaining the source scope.
